name: friendly-trails
description: Demo app for the talk "When (not) to use server components in interactive web apps".

scripts.dev:all: npx -y firebase-tools@15.35.0 emulators:exec --project demo-friendly-trails --only auth,firestore --ui "npm run seed && npm run dev"
scripts.prod:local: npx -y firebase-tools@15.35.0 emulators:exec --project demo-friendly-trails --only auth,firestore --ui "npm run seed && NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true next build && next start"
scripts.check:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@15.35.0 emulators:exec --project demo-friendly-trails --only auth,firestore "npm run seed && node scripts/check-rules.mjs"
